question: Which state government has mandated the incorporation of QR codes on all new road signages to provide manufacturer and warranty details?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Delhi government, through the Public Works Department (PWD), has made QR codes mandatory on all future road signages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Delhi PWD has mandated QR codes on all new road signages.**
 
• The QR codes will display manufacturer details, materials used and warranty information.
 
• The directive was issued on January 1, 2026.
 
• The move aims to ensure uniformity, transparency and improved visibility of road signage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Public Works Department (PWD) Initiative__

 __
 
• QR codes to be printed on the bottom right corner of retro-reflective signages.
 
• Includes details like manufacturing date, reflective sheeting code and warranty.
 
• Warranty period for reflective sheeting fixed at 10 years.
 
 
 
• PWD Sewa App Integration__
 __
 
• QR codes will be linked with the PWD Sewa mobile application.
 
• Citizens can report issues related to roads, potholes and signboards.
 
• Further grievance platforms will be added in later phases.
 
 
 
• Background__
 
 
• Ministry of Road Transport and Highways flagged lack of uniform signage in 2024 audit.
 
• Multiple agencies involved earlier led to non-standard road signages.
 
• The initiative strengthens accountability and citizen participation.
